title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Documented Oakland University study settings, including quiet library floors, collaborative work areas, and campus common spaces.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Kresge Library · second floor
cards.notes: Set up here for desktop access, printing, or shared project work. Use the second-floor service desk when you need library or technology help.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor library workspace with computers, study areas, and collaboration-oriented seating.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries identifies Kresge Library's second floor as its main floor with computers, cabanas, study rooms, and collaboration areas.
cards.access_notes: Inside Kresge Library; consult the library's current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Kresge Library Cabanas
cards.subtitle: Kresge Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use a cabana when your group needs a shared screen for a working session. Keep the conversation focused and leave the setup ready for the next users.
cards.short_summary: Second-floor group-study seating with large-screen computer collaboration tools.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries lists cabanas with wall-mounted computers on Kresge Library's second floor and recommends that floor for group study.
cards.access_notes: Located on Kresge Library's second floor; availability is not reservable through the cited page.

cards.title: Media Collaboration Rooms
cards.subtitle: Kresge Library · second floor
cards.notes: Choose a media collaboration room for a project that benefits from a large shared display. Confirm room availability and any booking requirements before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A library option for groups working with shared-screen media and project materials.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries lists media collaboration rooms among the second-floor group-study options at Kresge Library.
cards.access_notes: Located in Kresge Library; check the library's current space and reservation information.

cards.title: Kresge Library Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Kresge Library · quiet study floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing that benefits from a quieter setting. Avoid calls and large group meetings, as the floor is designated for quiet study.
cards.short_summary: The library's quiet-study floor, with individual tables and study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries states that Kresge Library's third floor is the quiet study floor and lists individual study tables and study rooms there.
cards.access_notes: Inside Kresge Library; follow the floor's quiet-study guidance and check building hours.

cards.title: Kresge Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Kresge Library · group-study floor
cards.notes: Meet here when your work needs conversation and shared materials. The floor has group tables, study rooms, and a media collaboration alcove.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor library setting designed around group study and collaborative seating.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries identifies Kresge Library's fourth floor as ideal for group study and lists group tables, a media collaboration alcove, and study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Inside Kresge Library; fourth-floor study rooms are first come, first served according to OU Libraries.

cards.title: Reflection Room 426
cards.subtitle: Kresge Library · fourth floor
cards.notes: Use this named room for a brief reset between study blocks, then return to your work with a clear plan for the next task.
cards.short_summary: A named reflection room on Kresge Library's fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries lists a reflection room, Room 426, on the fourth floor of Kresge Library.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Kresge Library; observe room guidance and check the library's current building hours.

cards.title: Medical Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Kresge Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use an individual room for focused work if you qualify for the space. The listed medical-library study rooms operate while the Kresge building is open.
cards.short_summary: First-floor individual and group study rooms associated with Oakland University's Medical Library.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries states that Medical Library study rooms on Kresge Library's first floor are open whenever the Kresge Library building is open, with individual rooms first come, first served.
cards.access_notes: Medical Library study rooms are listed as open when Kresge Library is open; individual rooms are first come, first served.

cards.title: Engineering Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Engineering Center · campus common area
cards.notes: Use the atrium's common-area setting for a study block between engineering classes. Bring your own device and select a seat that suits the work you need to do.
cards.short_summary: A named campus common area identified by Student Involvement as a study location.
cards.evidence_claim: Oakland University's Office for Student Involvement lists the Engineering Center atrium and other common areas among campus study spots.
cards.source_title: Commuter Connection | Office for Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: A common area rather than a reservable room; building access conditions may vary.

cards.title: Human Health Building Common Areas
cards.subtitle: Human Health Building · floors 2–4
cards.notes: Settle into a couch or other comfortable seating on floors two through four for independent work. Keep your materials compact in this shared common area.
cards.short_summary: Common-area seating on three floors of the Human Health Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Oakland University's Office for Student Involvement lists Human Health Building common areas with couches and comfortable seating on the second, third, and fourth floors as study spots.
cards.source_title: Commuter Connection | Office for Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: Shared common areas; building access conditions and available seating may vary.

cards.title: Student Technology Center
cards.subtitle: Oakland Center · campus student center
cards.notes: Use this campus technology location when your assignment requires a workstation or technical help. Check the center's current services before planning a long session.
cards.short_summary: A named Oakland Center technology resource listed among campus study locations.
cards.evidence_claim: Oakland University's Office for Student Involvement lists the Student Technology Center in the Oakland Center among campus study spots.
cards.source_title: Commuter Connection | Office for Student Involvement
cards.access_notes: Located in the Oakland Center; consult the center for current hours, access, and available technology.
